text:
Violence‑free, effortlessly obtained, the sustainer of food, the wind‑created (or wind‑borne) giver, the tiger‑like (fierce) one, the cattle‑tending, the sprout‑bearing, the satisfied one who lies upon the earth—  
the one whose conduct (nature) is capable of crossing the ocean of worldly existence, the one who has performed that (great) act; may men continually seek Him, for all qualities (virtues) ultimately lead to the end.
